notes.title: Update Patch v 0.6 - Welcome to THE ENDLESS SURGE
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are excited to announce that a new mode is now available in the game! ENDLESS SURGE!!! 

* HIGHSCORE LEADERBOARD*
Try to get as many points as you can by blowing up waves and waves of mechs coming for you. Do you have what it takes to take the #1 spot in the leaderboard? 

* GRIND GRIND GRIND * 
This mode is not only fun but will also help you get to the level you need to beat any story hunt mission or mini-hunt! 

* BE FAST OR THINGS MIGHT GET A BIT EXPLOSIVE *
At the end of every Endless Surge stage there's a little surprise waiting for you. It's explosive and it might hurt, so if you don't want to find out beat the timer and clear the stage! 

OTHER UPDATES:

* VR WEAPON HAND SETTING* 
You can now set the angle of rotation that you might find comfortable when you play! This is both available in main menu and in-game.

* MAGMA LABS REWORK*
We have updated the layout of the Magma labs ! We included certain zones that will help you battle against enemies and also take cover from Daqraq's attacks! 

- UI Updates for new Events in Game.

Bugs Fixed:
- Fixed bug that prevented OpenVR (Vive) from activating on start
- Fixed bug that prevented second controller to start on splitscreen. 

Thanks to those of you who have provided feedback while we are working on the game! We hope you have fun with the new updates !

Happy Hunting!

tags.feature: - VR WEAPON HAND SETTING*
- MAGMA LABS REWORK*
- UI Updates for new Events in Game.

tags.bug: - Fixed bug that prevented OpenVR (Vive) from activating on start
- Fixed bug that prevented second controller to start on splitscreen.

notes.title: Update Patch v0.5.3 - VR Updates + Daqraq Fight Rework
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
There's a new update of Mech League: Hunting that comes with new updates that not only fixes bugs but will also make gameplay more fun and rewarding

MAJOR UPDATES:

* NEW POINTAGE SYSTEM*

Points that you get from enemies have been updated! You will no longer get the same small tiny value when you kill a Minotaur for instance! Each of them will give you points! So the larger the enemy, the more points you get. If you play with a friend, make sure you focus on getting all the big mechs! UI message that spawns after each kill has been spawned. Go take tons of mechs to check it out :)

* TROPHY ROOM UPDATE*

Go check out the rework to the trophy room at the back of your HUB! We felt like we could make it a bit more interesting! Let us know what you think! 

* WEAPON MODS OVERHAUL*

We felt like they didn't do justice to the weapons and decided to tweak them. We also removed  some mods that didn't make sense for some weapons (e.g accuracy for snipers), but we have compensated by adding a few more (e.g range for shotguns). 

* DAQRAQ FIGHT REWORK* 

Just as we did with the Megataur fight we are currently updating Daqraq's fight! Let's say that you will need to keep an eye out to the sky just in case, and don't forget that hot lava! We are still working on it, to make sure that's both fun and badass! 

Minor Updates :

- Updated Weapon Angle for VR mode

- Heavy Rifle and Snipers have now been updated to use a new hitscan that will allow you to land shots easily. 

- Two new types of grenades have now been added! This is to add more variety later on in the game.

That's all for now! We are hoping to bring you guys the new mode "ENDLESS SURGE" on the next update! Keep an eye out!

Happy Hunting!

WEAPON MODS OVERHAUL
DAQRAQ FIGHT REWORK
Updated Weapon Angle for VR mode

notes.title: Patch Update v 0.5 - VR-Mode Update, Objectives Reworks and More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
We are excited to announce that a new update is now up! 

MAJOR UPDATES:

* Movement Mode in VR * 
You can now select how you want to move in VR mode, either by controlling movement based on the direction you are looking, or body direction. You can change this in the VROptions menu in the main menu! 

* VR Bugs Fixed *
We encountered a lot of bugs when playing in VR. Issues due to position should now be fixed, there's now an option in the menu that will also allow you to reset your position in case that you are not centered. The grenade button for Vive controller has now been set to "trigger" just as showed in the control display.

*Objectives Rework *
Hack Objectives will no longer re-spawn enemies when hacking a point. We felt like this would end up on a lot of frustation if you aren't able to hack the point due to being overwhelmed by enemies. Demolotion Delight has also been updated, enemies will now spawn at different points which will make it less predictable. 

* Megataur Missions Rework * 
The Megataur fight has been updated! We felt like the fight could be more interesting than it was! We have added a few surprises on it! We hope you have fun fighting him! :)

* Aqualis Colosseum Rework*
Aqualis Colosseum has also been updated to give you a better stage to fight against the Megataur! We feel like this change has made it better not only for the player but also for enemies! 

* Motion Blur * 
You can now turn on/off motion blur through the graphics option. However, this option is DISABLED when you play on VR or Splitscreen due issues with UI. 

Other Updates:
- New VFX have been added to some of the weapons, more to be updated! 
- New UI updates for notifications, and selection screens. 
- VR Bugs regarding to position and input has now been fixed! 
- Bug on splitscreen that didn't give players; accurate points has been corrected.

There's still more to come. Next on our list is the new mode "Endless Surge" and also a few updates on splitscreen selection screen. We really appreciate the feedback we have got from some of you! Thanks to you we have been able to find and fix some of the bugs! 

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Patch v.0.3 LEADERBOARDS, KILL STRIKE BONUS & MORE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
A new update is now live with major changes!! 

MAJOR UPDATES:

* LEADERBOARDS *

Leaderboards have been updated to reflect players with higher scores and lowest time separately. We did this because we found that both do not work well together! They are now visible on the Community Hub! so go ahead and show off your hunter skills!

* KILL STRIKE BONUS *

We thought about making the gameplay a bit more interesting, so now you will be able to aquire a bonus on your kill points by pilling up those kills within a short period of time! The max bonus you can get is 30%! And to keep it just SHOOT AT EVERYTHING THAT MOVES!

* MISSION BALANCING*

We have updated Hack Run missions and boss missions, they now all have a timer. We noticed that having no timer on these didn't make sense, and also will make you think about a better strategy to beat the missions! We will continue balancing the missions. 

* MINI HUNTS ADDED*

All planned Mini-hunts have been added into the game. There's a total of 60 MISSIONS that you can unlock through the story mode!! 


OTHER UPDATES:

- Player animation have been added for idle, walk, and jump.

BUG FIXES:

- Fixed a bug that fired wrong Audio in announcer dialogue. 

This is all for now! I hope you guys enjoy the new changes ! We look forward to hear your feedback! There's still more awesome things coming!! :)

HAPPY HUNTING!

notes.title: Patch v.0.3 LEADERBOARDS, KILL STRIKE BONUS & MORE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
A new update is now live with major changes!! 

MAJOR UPDATES:

* LEADERBOARDS *

Leaderboards have been updated to reflect players with higher scores and lowest time separately. We did this because we found that both do not work well together! They are now visible on the Community Hub! so go ahead and show off your hunter skills!

* KILL STRIKE BONUS *

We thought about making the gameplay a bit more interesting, so now you will be able to aquire a bonus on your kill points by pilling up those kills within a short period of time! The max bonus you can get is 30%! And to keep it just SHOOT AT EVERYTHING THAT MOVES!

* MISSION BALANCING*

We have updated Hack Run missions and boss missions, they now all have a timer. We noticed that having no timer on these didn't make sense, and also will make you think about a better strategy to beat the missions! We will continue balancing the missions. 

* MINI HUNTS ADDED*

All planned Mini-hunts have been added into the game. There's a total of 60 MISSIONS that you can unlock through the story mode!! 


OTHER UPDATES:

- Player animation have been added for idle, walk, and jump.

BUG FIXES:

- Fixed a bug that fired wrong Audio in announcer dialogue. 

This is all for now! I hope you guys enjoy the new changes ! We look forward to hear your feedback! There's still more awesome things coming!! :)

HAPPY HUNTING!

notes.title: Patch Build v 0.2.1 - STORY MODE DIALOGUE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We are excited to announce that we have now added in the story mode dialogue! 

In story mode, you will help Shade! She's a rogue hacker who's trying to take down the giant EVIL organization MECH LEAGUE: HUNTING! She will brief you at the beginning of each mission! 

Mission briefing becomes available once you have completed each mission, you can listen to it in the story mode screen! 

OTHER UPDATES:

- New visual effects for announcer warp! 
- Added sound effects to a couple of  screens in UI!
- Added Stand Your Ground mini-hunts!  

BUG FIXES: 

- Fixed bug that made player character bounce when walking down slopes!

We hope you enjoy the game and look forward to any feedback! 

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Update Build v 0.1.9!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
A new build is now live that contains some bug fixes and updates!

BUGS FIXED:

- Fixed error that occurred whenever first player weapon was not equipped to first slot during tutorial.

- Fixed shotgun hitscan that prevented registering targets that were hit.

- Fixed Daqraq bug that prevented him to move during mission 10.

- Fixed Magma Labs bug that prevented lava from going down after mission was completed.

UPDATES:

- New sfx in loadout selection for when you select, equip or de-equip a weapon.

- Leaderboard panel has been updated

- Updated UI in HUB for VR mode, menus are no longer attached to camera. 

- Updated UI in Tutorial for VR mode, dialogue subs + tutorial tips have been moved to a more readable spot! 

Watch out for the next update! We look forward to your feedback! :) 

Happy hunting!

Hello everyone! 
A new build is now live that contains some updates and also fixes!

- Enemies going after dead player in splitscreen

- Updated spawners in Stand Your Ground missions! We felt like we could make it a bit more interesting and have enemies move faster to the eneergy container by moving the spawners.
